about: Labels in answer order, the phrase each one's hypothesis is made of (template with {} = the phrase), the urgency pair, the premise's token cap (256, as measured) and the onnxruntime threads for this model: 4 cores, not spinning between runs, so llama-server on the same machine keeps the rest. The 11-20 latency (620 ms median) was measured at onnxruntime's default (threads 0 = one per core, spinning); measure 2, 4 and 0 with --check-intent --intent-threads 2,4,0 at deploy and put the chosen count here.
